# Subway Seat for zsh-syntax-highlighting

The same command-line colours as the fish port: gold commands, orange keywords and separators, sage options, avocado strings, terracotta expansions and redirections.

[zsh-syntax-highlighting](https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/zsh-syntax-highlighting/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.zsh`](subway-seat.zsh) | ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat.zsh |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.zsh`](subway-seat-tunnel.zsh) | ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-tunnel.zsh |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.zsh`](subway-seat-enamel.zsh) | ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-enamel.zsh |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.zshrc, next to where zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded:

```sh
source ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat.zsh
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.zshrc, next to where zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded:

```sh
source ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-tunnel.zsh
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.zshrc, next to where zsh-syntax-highlighting is loaded:

```sh
source ~/.config/zsh/subway-seat-enamel.zsh
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
